ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low macro-level contrast; the fluke surface is composed primarily of low-intensity dark gray pixels with high-intensity white pixel counts restricted to clusters at the distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deeply recessed U-shaped central notch with a sharp interior vertex angle and significant vertical depth relative to the fluke's horizontal axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular jagged contour with varied pixel-amplitude peaks and valleys along the entire trailing boundary, isolated from the lighter sky background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex mathematical curve sweeping upwards and outwards from the central notch towards the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized high-contrast clusters of circular white pixel groups detected specifically at the distal tips of both the left and right lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of distinct, raised high-intensity clusters on distal tips, identified as barnacle colonization or localized scarring.
